description: Image Description: The image features a rustic, textured wall with visible signs of wear, including chipping paint and a rough surface. In the center of the image is a tall, rectangular window with a dark green frame and divided into six panes. Behind the window, a colorful kite is prominently displayed, positioned vertically. The kite has a geometric design with three bold colors: green, red, and blue, arranged in a triangular pattern. The upper portion of the window shows light pink curtains, partially visible
